items.title: Glover Compton Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: You mentioned that you knew Sidney Bichet over in Paris too. Yes, yeah, very, very well.

ctx.x: But I never did know what type of singer she was, or if she just ran a club, or what?

No, she was raked. Like Ragtime, the one, they hadn't given them all that style of music all those different names in those days. Yeah. Ragtime, Swing, and I don't know what they're going to name it next. Rock and Roll. And it all comes under the heading of Ragtime. Yeah, I think so too. Every one of those different styles. And the drum is responsible for the different names. Different beats, you know, and then the different tunes. You mentioned that you knew Sidney Bichet over in Paris too. Yeah, this particular…
